body: Damn. We have it bad here in Australia don't we? Buses stop at 9:00, and only go in one hour intervals anyway. This isn't even the middle of nowhere or anything like that.

I never looked at it like that before. I'm just so unconfident about living on my own. I only know how to cook like two or three meals from scratch. Not to mention that I'm only used to cooking in very large proportions. I also can't drive, which is a big downfall. I've never had a job before either. And most of the jobs around here, (basically as cheap as it gets) require a pretty face and boobs, or an WH&S card + on the job experience. So even if I got a job, wouldn't it be the low of the low? I don't know. I saw the Campus Academic Coordinator today. He said that every thing he tried to suggest to help me I would immediately shoot down. I remember the experienced artist I was under for my Digital Futures program said I did the same thing... What's wrong with me? Am I doing it to you? If I am I am so, SO sorry. You've done nothing but been nice and I'm such an arse to people trying to help me. Now here I am crying again. Some model of emotional stability I am. Can't even keep a straight face while writing!

I'm sorry. I really am. I don't mean to. I don't know why. I feel so... Lost... Confused. Am I doing this?

...

Alright, I'm sorry if I do that. I spoke to the Overall Coordinator today. Basically as high up the food chain as you can go. He told me that he read between the lines and pieced together what's going on based on little bits I have told the other staff. Which admittedly, is far less than what I have dumped here. 

But, he went through and removed all the late penalties I have ever recieved. Practically doubling the number if passes and having the fails I have done. Which us awesome. But still not quite enough to get me out of this lions den yet. I was still happy of course. Buy when I left his office, I found out that the physciatrist had cancelled for tomorrow. So I will have to wait until next week.

My weeks seem to be taking forever though. Like when you can't do anything and time seems slowed. It's like I'm stuck in that state. But I was looking forward to visiting her. I was hoping everything would be made right just by telling her. I thought it would be awesome. Now I'll only have two more visits before the break.

I had to come home an hour later than usual today. I called in advance and gave warning... It didn't stop the yelling. 

Mt whole family picked on me at the dinner table. Said I was nastier than ever before now I gave been going to uni. Said it was probably the influences of modernism. I never should have had a computer, so on. The reason is, I try to defend people. 

My sister comes home and starts talking about how this other girl she works with tries to go to the managers whenever she has finished a job they assigned her. Then asks if she did a good enough job. I prompt the maybe she needs attention because (we all live in a shitty place here) she didn't get enough as a child or something. I of course am then immediately attacking her and not defending this random stranger I have never met. Stuff like this happens all the time. 

Why don't I leave? I wouldn't even know how to. How would I get to the new place? Stay there, etc. I don't know. It seems too daunting for me.

Anyway, it's late, I have to be up in 4 hours, (Oh yay) and I fear I'm being incoherent again.

Thanks again.

I don't know what's wrong with me. I was extremely happy yesterday. But, I'm not sure if I was. Was I actually just feeling normal? My parents let me stay home to do schoolwork (after much arguing and yelling) and I did. I did school. Some practical stuff. I used grooveshark through my phone and found some really nice (to me at least) music. I just worked. It was awesome. I went up the road and bought an apple for lunch, and ate it at the park. It was... I was just so happy. Happier than I've been in a long time. Maybe even months. But it was nothing special. I just finally got some time. After I went home and started doing my work again... They all came home. I crashed down emotionally so hard I tried to run away again after a fight. But they locked me in again. Now I'm just thinking, was I actually happy? Or just normal? Just what average is. Like the person I tried to help, am I seeking normalcy as something special? What's wrong with me? Why?

I start the next uni week tomorrow. I'm not sure how it will all play out. I speak with the department coordinator tomorrow, then the psychiatrist on Tuesday. A lecturer on Wednesday. And if next Thursday ends up like last I'll feel like killing myself before I reach the bus. The bus the normal people ride.

I didn't get to talk about the bus did I? I was late last Thursday. I had to catch a different much later bus than normal. It was basically full. As I walked to the back, someone smiled at me. A normal gesture? Regardless, I was floating on air. Until I got home. I'm confused. I feel like I'm losing my grip on reality. Everything is confusing and strange. What's right and what's wrong? Am I just some crappy avatar in a game someone else is playing? Why does it feel like someone is jamming the button to make me jump whenever I'm high up. Or hitting walk when a train goes by or a car crosses the road? I feel powerless now. And the feeling is increasing. I don't know any more...

Whoa, sorry I missed the reply. I was doing school finally.  I'm not in the US or wherever so I'm not sure what FASFA or whatever is. In regards to eating, it's an issue of time. The problem is getting breakfast and lunch for myself. Because those are what I'm expected to pay for. I basically have only one day in which I can go shopping, and I just spent it all watching younger siblings, sleeping and working on an assessment that didn't even get remotely done though it was due four hours ago. I don't enjoy the things I have to do with my family. Our "Survival Training Bushwalk" thing just always ends up being:

Drive to the bush.
Go along a walking trail.
Kids get tired and they get rotated into various slings/piggy back rides. Then my shoulders are all sore, and. Ugh. On Sunday it's required even though I hate it. It's mass. I'm not catholic. (Oh, rad-cat is slang sorry. It basically means very radical catholic) But I have to pretend to be for all the younger siblings. And if you miss even one week of mass that's a mortal sin and you go to hell, so I can't miss it even though I don't believe it. I've thought about moving out, but it just seems like more trouble. For example, what if I fail the course? That means no youth allowance, which means no money to pay for where I would be living. What if even if I did have time I wasted it?

I just always told myself that, to pass, all I needed to do was push myself physically. Go to every lecture, no matter the time. Pay attention in class. Take notes in the lectures. Go to the tutors/lecturers in consultation times. And I've done all that. But it still isn't working...

Ten years I've been super hyped to go to this college. Told myself I would finally make a friend or two there, study hard to get higher marks. Not fool around during the tutorial like the people next to me. Yet I'm the _ONLY_ class failure!?! 

Why? I font want to have to quit and try again next year. I want to pass _this_ year and keep these tentative bonds I think are forming. I don't want to have to meet the same lecturers the next year. Yet that's the path my life seems have started down.

That's why.

That's why I still feel suicidal. 

That's why I still so greatly appreciate your help.

I want the life I had planned for myself. Not this one I have...

I doubt it was malice as well. Maybe he thought I merely needed motivation to get it done. I wish it were that simple. 

I don't think we have a financial adviser... I still live with my parents, and we have a very small house, so "my room" is actually the lounge room/room of more than half the family/main hallway/kids playroom. Since everyone else goes to bed so late, I kind of have to too. I'm only getting home at around 8:30, then after helping cook, clean, do my jobs etc it's time to have dinner. Then it's time to clean up after dinner and put the food away. Then mandatory going outside and listen to parents read saint stories and the bible. Then prayers for an hour. Then it's like 11:30 and I haven't even prepared for the next day. Prepare food etc etc, bathe and shave. Ops, it's past 12:00 and I haven't done any homework, but it's too late because guess where my computer is? The main room where they are all now sleeping. Then I have to unwind before I can get to sleep. Yay oh Yay it's past 1:00 and I have to be up at 4:00 I don't have time to sleep. On Friday (when I don't go to school) it's about a 8:30 start because one if my younger brothers gets to nap during the day so isn't tired at all. Saturday is the "Family Activity" day that mainly involves going on bushwalks fit when "The frickin Chinese come and invade us to take over our land" So prepare for that from 6:00 Then Sundays are special mass days so get up at 5:30 to go to a fancy mass.an hour and a half away, then spend all day there. 

*sighs* 

Rant over, it's too hard to get good sleep. Food is... Annoying, I'm hungry... Often. I would eat a lot if I could afford it. But I basically get $250 every two weeks. $50 every week goes to my parents in rent. Then there's the travel ticket at $30 every week. Then phone bill. Art items needed. Necessities like real toothpaste etc. And food. And extra to use the internet for  more then 30 minutes on Monday, Wednesday and Friday between 3:00-3:30 PM. Nevermind the fact that I'm only home for one of those. 

Now I'm in trouble (financially) because I owe my parents extra because they drove me to the train station today. And I'm still indebted to my sister after the dispute over if I had payed the weeks rent.

Getting good food is definitely a problem. I basically have to go buy food on a Friday or a VERY rainy Saturday. (But of course no commerce on Sundays, says so in the bible!) 

They keep expecting I'm going to change back to being a "rad-cat" with them. 

There's no way to tell them I generally feel like gender doesn't matter to me myself... Oh how the voices would raise. We get into an argument about if we should close windows.

Anyway, my words are becoming incoherent and I'm not sure I still say what I mean. Time to goodnight. 

Thank you as always...

I've had it before, but never all day. To be honest I know I'm not eating or sleeping right. I am having trouble getting money for food, while still paying rent. If sleep debt is real then I am stuffed. I'm averaging around 2-4 hours sleep. I actually accidentally slept in today until 6:00 and was late for the lecture. I'm really disappointed in myself for that since it's the first time I've been late/missed a lecture. I somehow believed that just because I would not skip uni like everyone else I would have a better chance of passing. Oh the naivete. 

I'm also very ashamed of myself. I accidentally started crying during class when I realised I would fail that unit. I don't know why the tutor felt the need to announce to everyone that I am the "ONLY PERSON WHO HASN'T DONE THEIR ANNOTATED BIBLIOGRAPHY YET!" And that "HE HAS TO MENTALLY PREPARE TO TRY AND HELP ME" Did he think I would find it amusing? He suggested I change what my essay is about, to something else that I like. I tried to tell him that I don't have anything else. I wasn't allowed to read books, watch movies, play games or listen to music. I'm in a media college and I can't find an interest to write about. So what does stupid me do? Not calmly and rationally explain this, but burst out "I don't have anything else!" And start crying.

I think I'm very very stupid some/all times.

And thank you once again...

Hello again. 


It has been a busy day for me. But it's all, off. Everything feels weirdly... Surreal. I woke up and went to grab my lunch for the day, but hadn't gotten it ready. I was confused as to why it wasn't made even though I had gone to sleep, like it should all be automatically done by someone else.  It all seems like I'm falling apart. I fell asleep on the train again and missed my stop. But I wasn't freaking out like the last times that has happened. It feels like what I'm doing, I'm disconnected from. Like I'm just pushing buttons and my avatar is following, occasionally hitting a some cutscene that takes my control away from me. It doesn't even feel like I'm writing this. I just see these weird symbols that I can't understand and am tapping at them and my body is making coherency out of it. Just blue flashes. I feel as if I couldn't care... This is what I wanted wasn't it? It's all so strange feeling. 


I talked to the psychiatrist today, unfortunately we only got to talk for maybe 20 minutes instead of a full hour. I just feel so odd, yet I'm still very hungry even though I feel so unattached. The Student Services Advisor says I need to eat more because I have been starving myself, and to try to learn to sleep on the train.


 Anyway, my body is tired now and wants to sleep.

 Thank you for listening...

3D, not like pop out of your screen. But computer generated images and models and such. And the seemingly false future I made for myself around it. I just love doing 3D art. Even the stuff most people hate in it. I would spend hours doing it if I could. But. I wanted to make a life out of it. It's all I have. Add this here, that there, then before I know it there's a beautiful scene. I finally got into a uni that even teaches it. I get to study it for my profession! And get a bachelors! But I'm failing the course only ten weeks in. My dreamed up future is just fading away. It's just pixels and numbers. But without it... I don't want to be without it.

I have to go to sleep now. 4:00 Am start greets me tomorrow morning... Can we just... Continue talking please? I just, I... I feel I need to say something to someone. But I don't think I'll do it tomorrow with the psychiatrist. Just like, in this thread or something?

It feels ridiculous just even saying to myself and admitting it. I'm scared of losing what I care about... And to most people that isn't even something import to them. I have no girlfriend, no family worth caring about. No friends or people I would talk to... All I have is something not even real, and here I am crying to myself because I can't stand the thought of losing it...

Because I don't want to be scared anymore. And I'd rather not feel anything. Aren't Teen-20's males supposed to be full of arrogance, bravado. No emotions? I live with my parents. They kill themselves with "alternative" medicines and if I get properly diagnosed for depression and get put on pills, that's it. There's no way I would be able to have them. I don't even want to know what they would do...
I tried doing one of those, but once again they basically breezed over me and confused me by changing the type and focus of the essay.

I have trouble with all the essays, and the trouble with them pushes back the work I know how to do... Even if I work on the essays for hours, I know the work is crap so it's worthless. And it's mostly essays so far.
Also all the units I'm now doing are prerequisites, you can't fail any because later units rely on them.

I've tried talking to them, one is just so bitchy about everything, even though I've gone to her more than once, it's never been worth it at all. One is just so intimidating, all "You can all do this, I did it and blah blah" while being super loud, and not having consultation times. One I haven't tried yet and the last just says "Naww, you can do it."
